text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Upon returning to the academy after going out with Mejiro Bright—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh my~ Lady Fukukitaru. Good day to you~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ...What might that rather large box over there be for?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I'm so glad you asked!
Presenting this miraculous,
miraculous Jumbo Maneki-neko!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This morning's Good Morning Natto Fortune told me
'Good fortune lies to the east,'
so I went out for a walk, and—"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
The one radiating an extraordinary aura at the flea market
was this very Beckoning Cat...!,

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall take my leave now!
I must polish the beckoning cat until it shines brightly, after all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Heave-ho, hup...
Whoa, whoa, whoa-whoa-whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pop)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When Matikane Fukukitaru tripped, the wooden box
she was holding went flying and crashed onto the road—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(VRRRROOOOOOM)
(Crackle crackle...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fngyaaaaaaaah—!
The lucky cat got run over by the truuuuck!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dear. That's quite a pickle~
Trainer-sama, allow me to assist you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The beckoning cat had been reduced to a tragic state.
We all gathered up the pieces and brought them back to the Trainer's room for now, but—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Ah... The beckoning cat figurine got smashed to smithereens...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hauaaaa~ What should I do...!
At this rate, entering the Great Dark Period is inevitable...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Um, I have a suggestion~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: How about piecing the fragments of the beckoning cat together to repair it~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
She's right, Bright-san...! If they were large
shards it'd be one thing, but it's completely shattered...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If we take our time, I'm sure it will return
to its original form, don't you think~?
We managed to gather all the pieces, after all.
choice_data_list: Alright, let's give it a try...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Thank you both
soooo much...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ufufu, we're here to help one another out in times of need~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the restoration work began, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Even after sticking it out until nightfall,
it's still a long way from completion..."
choice_data_list: What a mind-boggling amount of work...
What a daunting amount of work...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
U-Uuuu...
My head is spinning...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san, on second thought, I'm okay now...
I'm going to pray to Lady Shiraoki for purification, confession, and to give a status update...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: No, no~ I think I'll keep going for a bit longer~. I've finally gotten the hang of it, you see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Now then, let us proceed nice and thoroughly from here♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as when she started the work,
Mejiro Bright kept moving her hands quietly and steadily.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, h-huh...? Wha...?
Before I knew it, I had fallen asleep...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, GYAWAAAH!
The sun is shining bright and clear!!
Isn't this a glorious good morning, now!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fukukitaru~,
please take a look over here.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... oooohhhhhh~?!
W-What in the world?! The beckoning cat is
completely and totally back to its original form... !?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: C-Could it be that you stayed up all night steadily working on the repairs, Bright-san!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I got so caught up in my work
that before I knew it, morning had come~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Bright spent the entire night
finishing a task that required an immense amount of patience...
choice_data_list: It didn't seem like it bothered you at all...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Talent, you say~?
I suppose working steadily and diligently is one of my strong suits, yes~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Lady Fukukitaru, if you happen to drop something again,
please do feel free to invite me along♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh...! I'll be super-duper careful
from now on so I don't cause
any trouble for Bright-san~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thus, Mejiro Bright displayed her phenomenal tenacity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was just like solving a puzzle,
I enjoyed myself immensely~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
"If there are other tasks like this,
I'd certainly love to try my hand at them, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
First, let's reach out to everyone
in the academy and see who's interested~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that training time was about to run out,
I gently stepped in to put a stop to it..."
